title: [D]  Has "AI research lab" become completely meaningless as a term?

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Has "AI research lab" become just a buzzword, or does it still drive real breakthroughs?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Labs now build AGI models, train on massive datasets, and deploy in real-time systems — the tech is evolving rapidly.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But ethical oversight is lagging; labs often prioritize innovation over transparency or accountability.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating safety layers, like value alignment and red-teaming, to mitigate risks as systems scale.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: I see a future where labs collaborate globally, sharing frameworks that ensure AI benefits all, not just a few.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The term may shift, but the labs that shape AI’s future will be those that balance ambition with responsibility.

video_cue: A montage of AI research labs, scientists collaborating, and ethical review boards in action.
